title: Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2024.2
description: Thank you all for your support. In version 2024.2, we have optimized GPU simulation, resulting in a significant improvement in your workflow efficiency. Additionally, we have enabled attachments to be simulated together with fabrics while maintaining collision effects, allowing for more natural results when creating items with multiple accessories (such as backpacks). We also bring you updates including soft selection for fabrics, optimizations for the GoZ plugin, and the addition of thickness options. Please click on the video to view the related content. Thank you once again for your continued support!
